body:
Encodes the six label dimensions, flags, ready gate and triage rules as a library crate and exposes trellis ticket new/triage/ready/sweep/scan/index. CLAUDE.md fixes the CLI surface by brief 4.12, so the surface is recorded in an ADR before any command lands. GitHub access goes through the gh binary, not a new HTTP dependency.

**Story acceptance:**
- An ADR records the trellis ticket surface
- trellis ticket triage reproduces triage.json for the current open issues
- Rules abstain rather than guess, and name the rule that abstained

title: S13: As a maintainer, I want the ticketing standard implemented as a trellis-tickets crate with a trellis ticket CLI so that labels, readiness and triage are computed rather than hand-applied
